misconfig_patterns: Only CORSMiddleware on FastAPI app — no AuthenticationMiddleware (frontend_app.py:166-175)
openai_api_key and dashscope_api_key default to literal string 'EMPTY' (py_config_modules.py:123-124) — these are upstream-call keys, not server auth
Port layout exposes 4 services per rank: server_port (HTTP), rpc_server_port (gRPC), cache_store_listen_port, cache_store_rdma_listen_port — START_PORT+1 grpc reachable if firewall too broad
/health, /status, /GraphService/cm2_status, /SearchService/cm2_status all alias to same health handler — broad surface to confirm liveness
/worker_status discloses dp_size, tp_size, role (prefill/decode/vit), running task list, cache utilization unauthenticated
/cache_status exposes available_kv_cache, total_kv_cache, block_size — directly maps GPU memory footprint
/set_log_level mutates server state from anonymous POST — INFERRED denial-of-service or log-flood vector
/update_scheduler_info and /update_eplb_config mutate scheduler from anonymous POST
/tokenize and /v1/chat/render leak chat template and tokenizer behavior

active_probe.false_positive_check: JSON must contain BOTH frontend_available_concurrency (added by frontend layer) AND dp_size/tp_size (returned by backend gRPC) — combination is RTP-LLM unique; sglang and lmdeploy do not expose worker_status at all

secondary_probe.discriminator: 200 OK with body 'ok' on a path named GraphService/cm2_status is a havenask service-mesh tell — confirms Alibaba search-stack lineage even without LLM-specific markers

deployment_tells: Port layout per rank: server_port = base+0 (HTTP), rpc_server_port = base+1 (gRPC), cache_store_listen_port = base+2, cache_store_rdma_listen_port = base+4 (worker_info.py)
RoleType env: PDFUSION (monolith default), PREFILL, DECODE, VIT, FRONTEND — visible in worker_status response 'role' field
Aliased health routes /GraphService/cm2_status and /SearchService/cm2_status are havenask service-mesh tells (RTP-LLM is a sub-project of github.com/alibaba/havenask)
Sub-application namespace prefix /rtp_llm/* on duplicate health/cache/worker_status routes
FastAPI with ORJSONResponse default — body is compact JSON without whitespace
frontend_concurrency_limit and frontend_available_concurrency keys added by frontend layer to every cache_status/worker_status response
/v1/embeddings/colbert and /v1/embeddings/sparse routes — RTP-LLM is one of few inference servers exposing ColBERT and sparse embedding endpoints
VipServer master endpoint pattern in MODEL_SERVICE_CONFIG env (Alibaba internal service discovery)
pivot_paths: GET /worker_status -> dp_size + tp_size + GPU role distribution + running task IDs -> infer cluster scale and current workload
GET /cache_status -> available_kv_cache / total_kv_cache / block_size -> infer per-GPU VRAM allocated to KV cache + active model context length
GET /v1/models -> served model name (often Qwen/internal models) -> attribution to Taobao, Tmall, Aidge, OpenSearch, Cainiao, Amap, Ele.me, AE, Lazada per README
POST /v1/chat/render -> dumps rendered chat template — leaks system prompt and instruction formatting
POST /tokenize -> tokenizer probe — leaks tokenizer family (qwen, llama, internlm) before any inference call
POST /v1/embeddings/colbert -> ColBERT late-interaction embeddings — distinctive endpoint, confirms multimodal/retrieval deployment
POST /set_log_level with body {"log_level":"DEBUG"} -> mutates logging without auth (low-impact pivot, log-noise generation)
POST /start_profile -> triggers profiler — INFERRED resource exhaustion / availability vector
Port START_PORT+1 (default 8089) gRPC backend reachable if exposed -> direct model_rpc_service_pb2 RpcServiceServicer access bypasses any frontend rate-limiting
/GraphService/cm2_status returning 'ok' on a non-search target = high-confidence Alibaba havenask lineage attribution
